alt: Colorful alphabet blocks, 3D models of Mars, the Moon, and Earth, and the letters E D U on a dotted white surface
caption: Colorful alphabet blocks sitting next to 3D planet models and the text EDUCATION
description: A collection of colorful alphabet blocks sits on a dotted surface next to 3D representations of celestial bodies. The scene includes red, yellow, and blue blocks with letters like A, B, and C. To the right, the letters E, D, and U spell out part of a word in grey. In the background, there are spherical models resembling the Moon, Mars, and Earth floating above the surface.
